Research Centre

We are establishing a Research Centre and are currently in partnership discussions with four higher education institutions across the United States, Europe, Africa, and Asia.

The Centre will study the experiences and practices taking place at the School—from relationships and embodied learning to meditation and contemplation. It will also offer visiting researchers a place to pursue questions of their own.

Read our manifestoContribute to our research

These projects share people, places and possibilities. Burzanella is their intended home.
